transcript:
That phenomenon was beneath contempt.
Holding the cheese in this world is tantamount to achieving total control.
I seem to have stepped in something, and what it is I dare not speculate.
I am stuck to the ground like the hapless patron of a discount movie theater.
This should help me conquer this deplorable disco dance floor once and for all.
Never could I have imagined being so excited over a piece of cheese.
This headpiece enables me to demolish walls with a minimum commitment of time.
Our glue-shooting backpack apparatus.
source: Maurice LaMarche · Pinky and the Brain: World Conquest original game dialogue
